findings.claim: Frozen P0 has 38 distinct callers with no missing caller/hash fields.
TLP over empirical md5(prosrc) equality reconciles exactly to 38: TRUE 16, FALSE 22, NULL 0, absent 0.
Changing comparator from md5(prosrc) to md5(pg_get_functiondef()) changes the equality outcome from 16 to 0; all 38 comparator outputs differ.
Trigger enabled-state TLP reconciles exactly to 21: TRUE 21, FALSE 0, NULL 0, absent 0.

invariants.statement: All frozen caller identities are populated and distinct.
Comparator substitution must not be assumed semantics-preserving.
